purpose: Preserve the pre-ledger public manuscript as historical v1. These files are evidence for claim-lineage research and must not be silently rewritten.
note: PREDICTIONS.md is frozen as a snapshot copy (claims/v1-snapshot/PREDICTIONS.md), not at its live path. The live PREDICTIONS.md is the project's working prediction register and the research lane writes to it continuously; freezing the live path made the gate go red on the next research commit (69b361a8, 2026-07-24) and, because verify_v1_freeze() precedes rendering, aborted the renderer entirely. The snapshot blob is byte-identical to PREDICTIONS.md@cf5cd3f0370c89b0e240659859fcfc6f68f1d241 -- same sha256, so the evidence guarantee is unchanged. frozen_on records the original 2026-07-23 freeze; frozen_at_commit points at the commit that added the snapshot, where all five frozen blobs coexist unchanged.
